rows.grounds: instrumental mudrayā plus optative āvāhayet; invoke by seal

items.question: How should the invoked goddess be meditated upon and invoked by seal in proper order?
items.inference: The rite requires meditative visualization followed by seal-invocation in sequence.
uncertainties: mudrayāvāhayet parses as mudrayā plus āvāhayet; exact seal unspecified
items.plain_english: Then, having meditated on that goddess as described, one should invoke her by the seal, in order.
